decision.statement: The point-to-object hypothesis is implementable as a bounded immutable file-backed slice using source-isolated OpenStreetMap snapshots, deterministic geometry and fail-closed evidence gates; route activation, external Preview, hosted persistence and Production remain unauthorised or blocked.

verifiedFacts: The root manifest binds 34 direct repository-local records; all 34 resolve within the repository and match exact bytes and SHA-256.
The UAE pack retains 967 normalized records, with 175 identity-eligible valid polygons or multipolygons.
The Singapore pack retains 1689 accepted records from 1691 inputs; two unsupported type=building relations are quarantined and 258 identity-eligible polygons or multipolygons are valid.
All 433 identity-eligible polygon or multipolygon geometries passed rollback-only PostGIS 3.3.7 validation; the persistent POINT_TO_OBJECT table count remained zero.
Ten deterministic safety fixtures passed exactly, with zero false-confident identity and zero grid-index false negatives.
The closed 44-field case-manifest contract, six rights obligations, physical realpath/hash/alias gates and six negative controls fail closed as specified.
The final independent correction audit and final representation-delta audit each returned PASS with P0=0, P1=0 and P2=0.
No application route, UI, API, model call, hosted persistence or Production behaviour was implemented by this data lane.

calculations.formula: 175 UAE eligible geometries + 258 Singapore eligible geometries

hypotheses: A disabled non-Production file-backed resolver can consume these immutable packs without hosted database persistence.
The bounded OSM identity path can support a truthful open-context object selection demonstration when ambiguity, missingness, rights and source conflicts remain visible.
The same response contract can be implemented by Dev without allowing the model to select, score or repair object identity.
counterEvidence: The Singapore anchor intersects two equal-priority building features and must return ambiguous rather than a preferred object.
Two Singapore type=building relations are unsupported by the frozen outline-union semantics and are quarantined.
A building-tagged point is context-only and cannot enter identity success.
The acquisition windows do not prove complete 800 metre context or real-world absence.
DB-01, AUTH-01, STORAGE-01 and SOURCE-01 remain FAIL; RLS authorization remains a failing DB/security sub-gate.
